title: ADR-028 closeout: mark review-lens and review-report as migrated
goal: Fix ADR-028 and its guard test to reflect that review-lens and review-report ARE migrated to _llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate, closing out the record left behind by #1840/#1843.

steps.description: Fix the guard test (write RED first, then fix to GREEN): update the header comment (lines 2-17) to describe review-lens as migrated rather than the unmigrated counter-example; fix SPEC-3 (line 74) to exclude comment lines when grepping for extract_first_json_object (add grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#' filter) so the test correctly takes the 'migrated' branch instead of matching the explanatory comment at plugin.sh:394; fix SPEC-2 (line 56) to add review-lens and review-report to the loop and to search all non-test .sh files under each plugin's directory tree (find .../plugin-dir -name '*.sh' ! -path '*/tests/*') so that review-report's parser in lib/lenses.sh is covered and not missed by a plugin.sh-only check.

Amend ADR-028 §Migration: (1) in the Per-stage gates list (around lines 181-185), add entries for _review_lens_envelope_schema_ok (review-lens/plugin.sh) and _rr_lens_envelope_schema_ok (review-report/lib/lenses.sh) with their gate criteria; (2) in the migrated-stage paragraph (around line 187), add review-lens and review-report to the list alongside plan, security-lens, monitor with a dated note citing #1840 and #1843; (3) replace the false 'not migrated' paragraph (around line 189) with a dated correction note; (4) remove the false 'review-lens was not migrated' sentence (around line 193). Preserve the existing 2026-09-02 correction note as history. Run npm test and npm run lint to confirm all green.

notes: All code is already correct — both plugins use _llm_envelope_parse --schema-gate (review-lens at plugin.sh:398 via _review_lens_envelope_schema_ok; review-report at lib/lenses.sh:162 via _rr_lens_envelope_schema_ok). Only two files change. RED step for SPEC-3: before the fix, grep on plugin.sh matches the comment at line 394 (which mentions extract_first_json_object to explain why it was replaced), causing the test to take the 'not migrated' conditional branch — the 'migrated' assertion never runs. After excluding comment lines, no match exists and the test unconditionally asserts the migrated state. SPEC-2 RED step: adding review-lens and review-report to the loop immediately exercises them; since the code is already migrated these new assertions go green immediately (no separate implementation change needed). ADR-028 should be checked against config/adr-enforcement-baseline.txt — if grandfathered, no Enforced-by section is needed; if not, a lint failure would require adding one. The prior checkpoint assumed it is grandfathered; verify before merging. review-report's lib/ directory contains no test .sh files, so the 'non-test .sh' find (excluding */tests/*) is unambiguous.
